facts.text: Mont Rochelle is a hotel and vineyard in Franschhoek at the foot of the Klein Dassenberg Mountain Range.
facts.excerpt: Escape to this picturesque corner at the foot of the Klein Dassenberg Mountain Range

facts.text: Mont Rochelle is a 45-minute drive from Cape Town.
facts.excerpt: Mont Rochelle is a 45-minute drive from Cape Town

facts.text: Mont Rochelle is within 35 minutes of the Stellenbosch, Paarl and Somerset West wine routes.
facts.excerpt: conveniently located within 35 minutes of Stellenbosch, Paarl, and Somerset West wine routes

facts.text: The hotel sits at the centre of the Mont Rochelle wine estate in the Cape Winelands.
facts.excerpt: nestled at the centre of the Mont Rochelle wine estate in the Cape Winelands

facts.text: The Cap Classique Vineyard Pool Suites have private terraces and plunge pools.
facts.excerpt: the Cap Classique Vineyard Pool Suites with private terraces and plunge pools

facts.text: Room types include Shiraz and Merlot Rooms and Pinotage Suites.
facts.excerpt: Choose from Shiraz and Merlot Rooms for cosy elegance, Pinotage Suites for spacious comfort

facts.text: The Mont Rochelle Spa has two treatment rooms and a hammam.
facts.excerpt: Step into the intimate Mont Rochelle Spa, featuring two dedicated treatment rooms and a revitalising hammam.

facts.text: MIKO is the signature restaurant, with 180-degree views of the Franschhoek Valley.
facts.excerpt: Choose MIKO, our signature restaurant with sweeping 180-degree views of the Franschhoek Valley

facts.text: Wine tastings are held every day at Mont Rochelle.
facts.excerpt: A wine tasting at Mont Rochelle isn't just a special event; it's an everyday occurrence

facts.text: The winery dates from the 1850s, was once a fruit packing shed and has National Heritage status.
facts.excerpt: Our 1850s winery, once a fruit packing shed, now functions as a traditional wine cellar

facts.text: Because of the winery's National Heritage status, all its white wine tanks are horizontal.
facts.excerpt: Due to the winery’s National Heritage status, all of Mont Rochelle’s white wine tanks are horizontal

facts.text: The Winemaker's Dinner includes a guided tour of the historic cellar with winemaker Michael Langenhoven and a five-course pairing dinner.
facts.excerpt: Join our esteemed winemaker, Michael Langenhoven, for a guided tour of our historic cellar, followed by an exquisite five-course pairing dinner

facts.text: The Franschhoek Wine Tram, a hop-on-off service, visits Mont Rochelle.
facts.excerpt: This charming and traditional hop-on-off service visits some of South Africa’s oldest and most distinguished wineries, including Mont Rochelle.

facts.text: Activities include hiking, mountain biking, lawn games and tennis.
facts.excerpt: Adventure enthusiasts can enjoy hiking and mountain biking

facts.text: Guests can enjoy lawn games and tennis and stroll the vineyards.
facts.excerpt: From lawn games and tennis to simply strolling the vineyards

facts.text: Guests can take in panoramic views of the Dassenberg Mountains from the pool.
facts.excerpt: soak up the panoramic views of the Dassenberg Mountains from the pool

facts.text: The Manor House is a private four-bedroom villa about a 10-minute walk from the main hotel building.
facts.excerpt: Just a 10-minute walk from the main hotel building and a stone’s throw from our winery, The Manor House is a private, four-bedroom luxury villa

facts.text: The Manor House has two private heated pools and a personal gym.
facts.excerpt: enjoy a swim in two private heated pools or stay active in your personal gym

facts.text: The Manor House has a games room with a pool table.
facts.excerpt: challenge friends and family in the games room with a pool table

facts.text: Vineyard picnics can be arranged on the estate grounds.
facts.excerpt: Make the most of the estate's beautiful grounds with a vineyard picnic

facts.text: Rooms feature exposed-beam ceilings and touches of whimsy such as neon ceramic bulldogs.
facts.excerpt: Exposed-beam ceilings and pops of whimsy (like neon ceramic bulldogs), lend humor

facts.text: Rooms overlook the valley through floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: airy rooms overlooking the valley through floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: The Country Kitchen is closed from 1 September for refurbishment; MIKO handles lunch and wine tastings meanwhile.
facts.excerpt: The Country Kitchen is closed from 1st September for a little sprucing up.

facts.text: Mont Rochelle is a 2026 TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice Award winner.
facts.excerpt: 2026 TripAdvisor Travellers’ Choice Award Winner
